grid.expression: SELECT ITE.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, SER.SERIE, CAB.NUMNOTA, CAB.DTNEG FROM TGFITE ITE INNER JOIN TGFCAB CAB ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFSER SER ON CAB.NUNOTA = SER.NUNOTA AND ITE.CODPROD = SER.CODPROD INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD AND PRO.USOPROD = 'V' WHERE CAB.CODPARC = :P_CODPARC AND TRUNC(CAB.DTNEG) >= :P_PERIODO.INI AND TRUNC(CAB.DTNEG) <= :P_PERIODO.FIN AND ITE.ATUALESTOQUE = -1 AND SER.ATUALESTOQUE = -1 AND CAB.TIPMOV = 'V' AND (CAB.CODEMP = 501 OR CAB.STATUSNFE <> 'D') AND CAB.CODTIPOPER IN (1100,2200,1111,1190,1124,2202)
